$comment: Copy of the name, version, dependencies, references and projectRef validation rules from driftsys/schemas project/v1.json (https://driftsys.github.io/schemas/project/v1.json). Only the fields used by the offline parity tests are included.

version.description: The org schema allows an empty string and rejects numbers. MarkSpec retains its tested empty-string rejection and numeric coercion.

url.description: MarkSpec also accepts local paths and scp-style Git URLs in dependencies, as required by its existing tests and guide.

name.description: The org schema accepts any string. MarkSpec retains its tested safe cache-directory name constraint.
